title: [WIP] Complete development for the Road Map
body:
- [x] **P5.1 Plugin Views - Mobile-First Layouts**
  - [x] ObjectGrid: column collapse on mobile, responsive row padding, card-view fallback below 480px, 44px touch targets
  - [x] ObjectKanban: snap scroll columns on mobile, touch DnD sensor, column count + swipe indicator
  - [x] ObjectForm: delegates to form renderer (handled in P5.3)
  - [x] ObjectDashboard: swipeable widget carousel on mobile, responsive grid fallback
  - [x] ObjectCalendar: auto-switch to day view on mobile, swipe navigation, event text scaling, long-press creation
  - [x] ObjectTimeline: description truncation on mobile, gantt label truncation, pull-to-refresh
  - [x] ObjectList: bottom-sheet-style action menus on mobile
  - [x] DetailView: mobile-friendly action menus, tap-to-copy fields with 44px touch targets
  - [x] Charts: reduced axis labels on mobile, legend stacking, touch tooltip support
  - [x] Map: pinch-zoom/pan, marker search, touch-accessible controls
  - [x] Gantt: responsive bar heights (32/40px), responsive zoom levels (35/50/60px columns)
- [x] **P5.2 Console Pages - Responsive Layouts**
  - [x] AppSidebar: swipe-from-edge gesture, touch-friendly padding, bottom navigation bar
  - [x] DashboardView: heading scale (text-lg/xl/2xl), metadata panel stacks on mobile
  - [x] RecordDetailView: scroll-padding for on-screen keyboard
  - [x] Create/Edit Dialogs: full-screen on mobile, swipe indicator handle
- [ ] **P5.3 Core Component Primitives**
  - [ ] DataTable: column visibility, scroll indicator
  - [ ] Form Renderer: field label scaling, touch targets, wizard mobile, step indicators
  - [ ] Navigation: breadcrumb truncation, tab scroll, dropdown bottom sheet
- [ ] **P5.4 Mobile Infrastructure**
  - [ ] Touch & Gesture System integration
  - [ ] Performance on Mobile Networks
  - [ ] PWA Support
- [ ] **P5.5 Testing & QA**
  - [ ] Playwright mobile viewport tests
  - [ ] Visual regression, touch interaction, axe-core mobile tests
  - [ ] Storybook mobile viewport decorator
- [ ] **Update ROADMAP.md** to mark all items complete
